advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Give the follower wait a bounded timeout (or have the sweep set the evicted entry's Event) so an already-attached follower cannot block forever on a wedged leader, matching the documented guarantee.
evidence: _mcp_inflight.py:161-166 '_sweep_locked' only does '_registry.pop(k, None)'; it never calls entry.event.set()
_mcp_inflight.py:14-16 docstring: 'a defensive max-age sweep reclaims a wedged/crashed leader's key so nothing is blocked forever'
_mcp_inflight.py:189-193 '_finish' (the only place event.set() is called) runs solely in the leader's finally in _run_leader; a leader that never returns/raises never sets the event
advisory.finding: The module docstring and _MAX_AGE_SECONDS comment claim the defensive max-age sweep guarantees a wedged/crashed leader's key is reclaimed 'so nothing is blocked forever', but a follower that has already attached blocks on `entry.event.wait()` with no timeout. The sweep only evicts registry entries at attach time and never sets the leader's Event, so a follower already waiting on a leader that wedges without reaching its finally (deadlock/infinite loop) waits forever.
scenarios: Leader thread deadlocks or hangs indefinitely inside work() (never reaches the finally); a follower already blocked in _await_follower is never released — the sweep evicts the registry key but the follower still holds its reference to `entry` and waits forever.

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a tool-level dedup test for verify_completion (or add 'verify_completion' to the parametrize list) proving two concurrent same-ticket calls invoke the gate exactly once.
evidence: src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:248-257 verify_completion added body: run_gate_singleflight("verify_completion", ..., variant=f"graph={graph};source={source or 'attested'}", ..., work=lambda: _verify_completion_body(...))

Named violating input: two concurrent call_tool('verify_completion', {'ticket_id': 'd80d'}) requests — if verify_completion were not wired through run_gate_singleflight the gate would run twice; no tool-level test covers this newly-added path (the parametrize list omits it).
blocking.finding: The tool-level wiring test parametrizes only ['review_plan'], so the newly-added verify_completion tool body that routes through run_gate_singleflight (with its distinct variant key f"graph={graph};source=...") is never exercised at the tool/offload level. A regression that fails to wire verify_completion through the registry, or that computes a non-deduping variant for it, would go undetected.
scenarios: A future edit removes/breaks the run_gate_singleflight wiring on verify_completion, or uses a variant string that never collides, so concurrent verify_completion retries double-charge — tool-level suite stays green.
blocking.suggested_fix: Extend the parametrize to ["review_plan", "verify_completion"] and monkeypatch rebar.llm.verify_completion with the same blocking fake (matching its keyword signature), asserting fake.calls == 1.
